countingPolicy.breweryVisitation: One explicit brewery-brand attendance memory per named brewery until the exact venue and number of visits are established; once confirmed, distinguish multiple distinct actual sites only with user confirmation.
countingPolicy.location: Brand-level confirmation does not establish which brewery address, taproom, brewery campus or country the user visited. Do not substitute brewery headquarters or award-entry city for attendance location.
countingPolicy.visitEvidence: User explicitly said 'I've been to...' for the seven brewery brands below. This is personal attendance evidence at an unspecified brewery venue, not evidence of a beer purchased at retail or a specific tour.
countingPolicy.recognition: GABF, World Beer Cup, Colorado Brewers Cup and comparable judged brewing medals qualify as brewery/beer distinctions, distinct from JBF, Michelin, CAMRA, editorial or brewery-specific hospitality awards. Store beer, medal, year and adjudicating body; medal for a product or a submitting site does not establish the user's physical site or the date of a personal visit.
countingPolicy.publication: All directly confirmed brewery-brand visits are included in the public visitor candidate records with unknown site and date retained. Story approvals and launch remain separate.
